news.title: Share Market Today. NSE & BSE Updates - Alice Blue

guidance: We are confident on Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited July 29, 2026 the stated guidance of 20%-plus advances growth for the current financial year.
So, just wanted to understand, first up, I mean, for the full year, we are still targeting 1.2% kind of an ROA rate.
risks: Coming to Q1 of current financial year business performance, despite a challenging operating environment and continued impact of elevated funding cost, the bank delivered a resilient and steady performance during Q1.
Encouragingly, despite the geopolitical tension in West Asia and the associated macroeconomic uncertainties, the quality of retail and vehicle finance portfolio remains intact.
focus: The benefit of our balance sheet growth, improving portfolio diversification and sustained progress in asset quality are now becoming more visible across our key earnings metrics.
This will add the diversified as well as opportunity for customer towards hedging and an opportunity for us to build the dollar balance sheet.
We are also encouraged by the response to a recently launched Artha proposition targeting HNI and HNI+.

about: Equitas Small Finance Bank Ltd before acquiring small bank license, operated as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Equitas Holding Ltd. The holding entity started its operations in 2007 in the microfinance segment & diversified into vehicle & housing finance in 2011. Also entered into SME & LAP in 2013.
